title: pl-forecast-bench: a leakage-checked forecasting benchmark for the Polish power system
description:
A benchmark of day-ahead and intraday (1-6 h) forecasts at 15-minute resolution for national wind generation, solar generation, power demand and the SDAC day-ahead price in Poland.

It fixes the data (PSE reports and archived ECMWF IFS forecasts through Open-Meteo, as download scripts with checksums), the as-of rules (publication time of every input), train/validation/test splits with a 12-month test year (October 2025 to September 2026), the metrics (MAE, RMSE, nMAE, pinball loss, CRPS, imbalance cost under a simplified settlement, profit of a battery scheduled by a MILP) and reference models (naive, the official PSE plan, ridge, gradient boosting, zero-shot time series foundation models), with tests that detect look-ahead leakage and a leaderboard open to submissions.

The archive contains code, configuration, checksums and scores; the PSE and Open-Meteo data are not redistributed.
